governance_note: Deep history uses exact 3-second Baidu Netdisk index observations. Daily incrementals use TDX history-transaction rows whose protocol time is minute-only; stable in-minute sequence order reconstructs 3-second labels. Both sources carry interval turnover, not security volume.

field_semantics.时间: exact source observation timestamp including seconds
field_semantics.成交额: interval constituent turnover in CNY; non-cumulative

source_contracts.session_semantics: 09:25 auction result, 3-second continuous observations, noon/final corrections, sparse closing auction

historical_coverage.per_series_start: first receipt-bound archive observation; launch-to-first-observation gaps remain explicit and are never fabricated

source_contracts.available_at_policy: archive retrieval time; no historical first-publication claim
source_contracts.revision_policy: remote fs_id, archive SHA-256 and immutable dataset_version bind each import
source_contracts.identity_mapping: six-digit CSV member resolved only through the governed index catalog

transport.kind: Baidu Netdisk daily ZIP, UTF-8 BOM CSV

enumeration.completion_proof: calendar x daily archive x catalog member ledger

source_contracts.coverage_envelope: catalog-selected members in one immutable daily ZIP
source_contracts.absence_meaning: missing member or timestamp is a source gap; no carry-forward is implied
known_limitations: from 2018-08-20 the 14:58-14:59 grid is closing auction and must stay sparse; 239 1m bars is the legal complete day
archive is a user-maintained historical lane
source_contracts.cross_validation_policy: overlap must reconcile row count, price and amount against TDX history transaction after deterministic timestamp reconstruction

field_semantics.sequence: stable provider order within each minute; rank 0..19 maps to seconds rank*3
field_semantics.vol: index interval turnover in hundreds of CNY; normalized amount=vol*100
field_semantics.buyorsell: provider placeholder for index observations; not a trade-side signal

source_contracts.session_semantics: same observation family as Baidu archive; reconstructed seconds must be overlap-validated
source_contracts.available_at_policy: retrieval time for observations; daily bars use governed schedule-bound availability
source_contracts.revision_policy: new retrieval creates a new immutable version
source_contracts.absence_meaning: unknown until another healthy DIRECT endpoint is attempted
source_contracts.cross_validation_policy: Baidu overlap must match price and vol*100 amount after stable sequence reconstruction; mismatches deny promotion
